title: strip-trailing-backticks-in-gradio-output
request: hey, the _clean_model_output helper in gradio_ui leaves stray ``` at the end of a response. can you make it strip those trailing backticks so the UI looks cleaner?
reference_diff:
--- a/src/smolagents/gradio_ui.py
+++ b/src/smolagents/gradio_ui.py
@@ -53,6 +53,8 @@
     model_output = re.sub(r"```\s*<end_code>", "```", model_output)  # handles ```<end_code>
     model_output = re.sub(r"<end_code>\s*```", "```", model_output)  # handles <end_code>```
     model_output = re.sub(r"```\s*\n\s*<end_code>", "```", model_output)  # handles ```\n<end_code>
+    # Strip stray trailing backticks that are not part of a code block
+    model_output = re.sub(r"`{3,}\s*$", "", model_output)
     return model_output.strip()

+++ b/tests/test_gradio_ui_clean_output.py
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+import pytest
+from smolagents.gradio_ui import _clean_model_output
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "inp,expected",
+    [
+        ("hello```   ", "hello"),
+        ("some output```<end_code>", "some output"),
+        ("plain text", "plain text"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_clean_model_output_strips_trailing_backticks(inp, expected):
+    assert _clean_model_output(inp) == expected
